mechanism: Independent power toggle switches for follower/leader x left/right; each follower has its own switch
location: Reachable from outside the robot workspace
notes: User reported that left and right follower power require separate switch actions. No power-off arm-behavior test was performed. Possible gravity sag/drop was identified only as an unverified concern and is not recorded as observed behavior. The current switch arrangement is not accepted as the emergency procedure for characterization.
